title: Vela project configuration
description: Schema for vela.config.json. Theme values are roblox-ts expression strings such as "Color3.fromRGB(59, 130, 246)" or "new UDim(0, 6)".

preflight.description: Neutralizes the Roblox defaults (opaque gray background, 1px border) on every className-bearing host element, so only explicit bg-* and border utilities paint. Set to false to keep the engine defaults.

colors.description: Replaces the whole default color scale. When present, theme.extend.colors is discarded.

radius.description: Replaces the whole default radius scale.

spacing.description: Replaces the whole default spacing scale.

fontFamily.description: Replaces the whole default font family scale. Values are Roblox font family assets such as "rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json".

plugins.description: What plugins contribute. A JSON config cannot hold a plugin function, so it states the already-resolved result instead.

utilities.description: Extra class names. A string is a list of vela utilities the class expands to; an object names Roblox properties directly, as roblox-ts expression strings.

motion.description: Replaces the built-in TweenService driver behind `transition` and `animate-*`. The runtime host is inlined into every transformed module, so the module has to resolve from any of them — a package name or a baseUrl-relative path, never a relative one.

export.description: Named export to import. The default export when omitted.
